page: Microsoft Azure D4alds_v7 is an x86_64 general purpose virtual machine featuring dedicated CPU allocation on an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor clocked at up to 4.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 4 vCPUs derived from 2 physical cores across 2 threads per core, supported by 48 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache. It provides 8.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware features include comprehensive vector instruction extensions such as AVX-512 with VNNI and BF16, alongside cryptographic acceleration via AES, VAES, and SHA-NI.

Storage consists of a bundled 236 GB local NVMe SSD, while GPU acceleration is not present. The server includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses and runs atop Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization with hardware SVM support. In synthetic testing, the high base frequency of the AMD EPYC core yields top-tier single-core performance, evidenced by a Geekbench single-core score of 2804.0, a stress-ng single-core rating of 3779.19, and fast single-threaded compression speeds (41.05 GB/sec in gzip).

Across multithreaded and parallel workloads, aggregate throughput remains moderate due to the 4-vCPU envelope. Geekbench multi-core registers at 6511.0, PassMark CPU achieves 10112.45, and Redis SET operations deliver 8.22 million operations per second. Memory throughput reaches 49.04 GB/sec for uncached 256 MB reads and 34.06 GB/sec for writes. The hardware profile represents a lean memory configuration that maximizes single-thread compute efficiency at a low resource footprint.

Given its 8.0 GB RAM boundary and fast per-core execution, Microsoft Azure D4alds_v7 is well aligned for lightweight web serving, CI/CD runners, batch text processing, microservices, and modest data transformations that benefit from local NVMe temporary caching without requiring large in-memory working sets.
description: Microsoft Azure D4alds_v7 is a compute-skewed general purpose instance powered by a 4.5 GHz AMD EPYC 9V45 processor. Configured with 4 dedicated vCPUs (2 physical cores), 8.0 GB of memory (2.0 GB per vCPU), and a bundled 236 GB local NVMe SSD, it delivers high single-thread efficiency supported by AVX-512 vector instructions and cryptographic hardware acceleration. Benchmark results show top-tier single-core CPU speed (Geekbench single-core 2804.0) alongside solid mid-tier multithreaded and static web serving throughput (8.81 GB/sec). With a compact memory footprint and fast NVMe temporary storage, the D4alds_v7 offers a cost-efficient profile for CPU-bound microservices, CI/CD build tasks, text processing, and caching layers that do not demand extensive RAM capacity.
